nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some potential health benefits of edible insects according to Wazowski et al.?
nodes.answer: Wazowski et al. discuss the potential health benefits of edible insects, highlighting their nutritional value, sustainable production, and potential to address food insecurity.

nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is done with any additional barley grain production beyond what is used for feed?
nodes.answer: Any additional barley grain production is assumed to be sold and substitutes other organic barley production at the market.
